# Copilot instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` first. This repo has a live Storybook of the Figma design system at `Trianglz/storybook/`: at the start of a session, tell the user and ask "Do you want me to run the Storybook, update it from Figma, or skip it for now?" Run it with `npm install` then `npm run storybook` in that folder (Node.js 18+, ask before installing); it serves http://localhost:6006 and a Storybook MCP at http://localhost:6006/mcp.
